title: LINUXDRV-003: GPIO/PWM export and unexport helpers return on the first failure without rolling back or continuing cleanup
summary: LINUXDRV-003: GPIO/PWM export and unexport helpers return on the first failure without rolling back or continuing cleanup. A partial connect failure can leave some GPIOs/PWMs exported, and a disconnect can stop after one unexport error while leaving the rest of the pins exported. Track successfully exported resources during connect and perform best-effort cleanup of all resources on failure and disconnect. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied. Current audit reconciliation: Current cleanup is best-effort and no longer stops at first failure. Remaining concrete ownership issue: rollback/disconnect can unexport resources already present before this driver session. Next: track per-session ownership and regress pre-exported resources plus partial setup failures; retain original provenance.

resolution.evidence: 20261025074335-0b62-fix-rpio-gpio-findings/verification.md; per-session ownership bits in rpio_sysfs, only session exports are unexported; 'pre-exported pins stay exported', 'failed connect keeps pre-exported pins', aux_rpio hardware case on Raspberry Pi 5 and 3B+.
